analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The single hunk at head lines 1561-1569 adds a paragraph on tokenizer byte-fallback decoding: LocalTokenizerBridge.decode releases a trailing run of <0xHH> tokens, a partial run reads as U+FFFD, and DetokenizerV2 holds that back. I read both base units (838-1644) for context. No code, configuration, trust boundary, key handling, attestation, authorization or cache behavior changes. The prefix-cache and PromptTokenCache text in the surrounding context is unchanged, so T-041 and SEC-035 posture is unaffected. The new text claims behavior in LocalTokenizerLoader.swift, which is not supplied here, so that source change was not verified. The described behavior is a decode-correctness fix for plaintext output on the provider. It does not touch the encryption of SSE frames sent to the coordinator (T-008), and it does not touch the at-rest cache. I found no security regression and no threat-model gap. The next pass could confirm that the accompanying Swift change does not alter the fail-closed encryption path or log decoded text.
